sentences.en: I've read a book that talks about the Blessed Trinity.
sentences.zh: 我读过一本书，书中讲述了圣三一。

sentences.en: Hinduism has a divine Trinity along with millions of lesser gods.
sentences.zh: 印度教除了成千上万的次级神祇外，还有一位神圣的三重神。

sentences.en: Trinity Square was the original center of St. Petersburg.
sentences.zh: Trinity Square 是圣彼得堡最初的中心地带。
